title: Case-insensitive customer lookup
question: Ускорь case-insensitive lookup без изменения результата. Подтверди решение планом и укажи цену поддержки индекса.
sql: SELECT id, tenant_id, email FROM customers WHERE lower(email) = lower('Customer4242@Example.com')

title: Заказы по редкому продукту
question: Ускорь запрос к заказам по product_id, сохрани агрегацию и семантику paid/non-test. Используй только оправданные индексы.
sql: SELECT o.tenant_id, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders_count, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS item_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.product_id = 341 AND o.status = 'paid' AND o.is_test = false GROUP BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY item_revenue DESC, o.tenant_id LIMIT 25

title: Редкая campaign в JSONB
question: Оптимизируй фильтр по JSONB campaign и времени. Не меняй оператор/семантику JSON containment.
sql: SELECT project_id, count(*) AS events_count FROM events WHERE properties @> '{"campaign": "campaign_347"}'::jsonb AND occurred_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY events_count DESC, project_id
